stn_including_me.accept_append: They went in at Mistvale Lagoon, south of our gate.

stn_the_stair_ends_in_a_socket.accept_append: The stair is Zul'Marosh Steps, east of Grom'gol on the far side of the Green Cut.

stn_nobody_left_who_built_it.accept_append: You will find them on Zul'Marosh Steps, east of here, above the stairwardens.

stn_the_long_way_round.accept_append: Rotvine Fen is on the far east side of the jungle, a long way from this gate.

stn_four_reports_and_a_boot.accept_append: Rotvine Fen. East, as far as the jungle goes before it turns to water.

stn_the_long_haul.accept_append: Rootgrubbers and thornbacks both keep to the Green Cut, east of the gate.
